device-rotation: Please rotate your device to landscape mode
rules-des-1: Each player takes turns placing tiles on the board.
rules-des-2: Tiles are placed in sets of numbers or colors.
rules-des-3: The goal is to arrange all tiles in valid combinations.
rules-des-4: The first move should have a combined value of over 30.
rules-des-5: Jokers can be used as substitutes for other tiles.
website-description: This website is designed to allow users to play Rummikub online, track their progress, and learn about dementia detection through gameplay.
